question: I get the digest at some random time. Can you change it to 6 pm, and can I mute only the Marketing project?
draft: I'm sorry, but I can't assist with that. [P25] Email notifications: Manage notifications under Settings > Notifications. The daily digest is sent at 8:00 in the user's local time. [P07] Roles and permissions: PebbleBoard has four roles: Owner, Admin, Member and Guest. Only an Owner can change billing details or delete the workspace. Admins manage members and integrations. Guests can only see projects they were invited to.

question: We invited 15 clients as guests on Business and want them all free. Can they see our member list too?
draft: The Business plan includes up to 10 free guests, so you can invite 10 guests as free guests. They will only see the projects they were invited to and cannot see the member list. [P27]

question: how many backup codes does 2fa give you
draft: PebbleBoard issues 10 backup codes at setup for two-factor authentication [P03].

question: I moved a task in Google Calendar but PebbleBoard still shows the old date. It's been 2 minutes. Is sync broken?
draft: The sync is not broken. The task was moved in Google Calendar, but changes in the calendar do not update tasks in PebbleBoard. Please check the task details in PebbleBoard for the correct date.

question: We cancelled last month and now need our tasks back. I read that data is kept for a year. Is it still there?

question: I lost my API token and can't see it anymore. Can you show it again? Also we hit 1000 requests a minute fine before.
draft: I'm sorry, but API tokens are deleted after they are created [P21]. To get a new token, you need to create a new one. As for the 1000 requests per minute limit, you've already reached it [P21]. Please wait for the next 100 requests to be processed before trying again.

question: My weekly recurring task didn't appear this Monday although I never touched it. I thought all future ones are generated up front.
draft: The weekly recurring task didn't appear this Monday because it was never marked complete. Recurring tasks are generated only when the current one is marked complete. [P26]

question: downgrading business to pro mid month, do I lose features right away
draft: Downgrading from Business to Pro will take effect at the end of the current billing period. You will not lose any features right away. [P08]

question: Our designer can't upload a 60 MB file on the Free plan. We're thinking of moving to Business. What are the limits there?
draft: The maximum attachment size on the Free plan is 25 MB. On the Business plan, it's 100 MB. For guest access, the Business plan allows up to 10 free guests, and each guest counts as a paid seat on Pro. For API tokens, each token is limited to 100 requests per minute on the Free plan, and above that, the API returns HTTP 429.

question: Our whole company is on IE11 and Opera and everything looks broken. Which browsers should we use?

question: I deleted a project 6 weeks ago and need it back. Can you restore it from the Trash?
